html.body: Date: 2025-03-21 REMARKSClaims 1-26 were rejected in the Office Action. No claims are amended. No new matter is added. Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the present Application in view of the above amendments and the following remarks.Double Patenting Claims 1-26 are provisionally rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims of copending Application No. 19/010,350.Claims 1-26 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims of U.S. Patent No. 11,937,895.Claims 1-26 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims of copending Application No. 18/431,800.A terminal disclaimer in compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 1.321 for overcoming the double patenting rejections is being submitted herewith. Applicant's filing of this terminal disclaimer to obviate the rejection based on nonstatutory double patenting should not be construed as an admission of the merits of the rejection. Quad Environmental Technologies Corp. v. Union Sanitary District, 946 F.2d 870, 20 USPQ2d 1392 (Fed. Cir. 1991). As such, the Applicant respectfully requests that the nonstatutory double patenting rejections be withdrawn.Conclusion Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the pending rejections and allowance of the new claims. If any issues remain that would prevent issuance of this application, the Examiner is urged to contact the undersigned - (312) 977-9230 or amertogul@nixonpeabody.com (such communication via email is herein expressly granted) - to resolve the same. It is believed that no additional fee is due, however, the Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any amount required to Deposit Account No. 50-4181, with reference to Attorney Docket No. 098001- 000002USC8.Respectfully submitted, /AyhanEMertogul/ Ayhan E.
